description: Emergency service lookup backed by live Serper search. Requests are scoped to the authenticated account's patient profile, persisted as emergency_requests and audited without location text or PHI. Live results are unverified; HealthAccess does not dispatch ambulances.

endpoints.name: Request emergency services
endpoints.summary: Search for nearby emergency hospitals and ambulance services and record the request.
endpoints.description: Requires a bearer token and a patient profile. Requires one of location, area_id, or a latitude/longitude pair; missing location fields fall back to the patient's home area. The area id must belong to an active area. Serper Maps is searched for emergency hospitals and/or ambulance services, results are persisted in the request record, and the request is audited with kind, status and result_count only. If the search provider is unconfigured the endpoint returns 503 search_unavailable before writing anything. If the configured search fails, the request is stored with status FAILED. An empty search stores status NO_MATCH and returns 201 with empty results. Always show the 112 guidance to the user.

bodyExample.note: Patient collapsed at the market gate

bodyFields.name: kind
bodyFields.description: hospital, ambulance or both. Default both.

bodyFields.name: location
bodyFields.description: Free-text area or landmark, 1-160 characters. Used as the search area and stored as location_text.

bodyFields.name: area_id
bodyFields.description: Area id from /directory/areas. Unknown or inactive ids return 404.

bodyFields.name: note
bodyFields.description: Optional operator note, max 500 characters. It is not persisted or audited.

responses.label: Created
responses.description: Search matched at least one live result. Results are unverified and include a source_url.

guidance: Call 112 now if the situation is life-threatening, someone is unconscious, bleeding heavily, or struggling to breathe.
Call the nearest facility below and confirm they can accept the patient before travelling.
HealthAccess does not dispatch ambulances; these are live search results and are not verified by HealthAccess.

responses.label: Created
responses.description: Search returned nothing. Status NO_MATCH with empty results; still show the 112 guidance.

guidance: Call 112 now if the situation is life-threatening, someone is unconscious, bleeding heavily, or struggling to breathe.
Call the nearest facility below and confirm they can accept the patient before travelling.
HealthAccess does not dispatch ambulances; these are live search results and are not verified by HealthAccess.

responses.label: Bad Request
responses.description: No location, area or coordinate pair was supplied.

issues.message: Provide a location, an area_id or both latitude and longitude

responses.label: Not Found
responses.description: area_id does not match an active area, or the account has no patient profile.

responses.label: Service Unavailable
responses.description: Live search is not configured. Nothing is persisted.

body.message: Live facility search is not configured

endpoints.curl:
TOKEN="<access-jwt>"
curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/emergency \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"kind":"both","location":"Allen Avenue, Ikeja","area_id":"20000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","latitude":6.6018,"longitude":3.3515}'
notes: Audit metadata contains only kind, status and result_count; the location text, note, coordinates and phone numbers are never written to the audit event.
status FAILED is returned as 201 with empty results when the configured provider errors; retry or ask the user to call 112.
results are persisted on the request, so GET /emergency/{id} returns the same snapshot.

endpoints.name: List emergency requests
endpoints.summary: Paginated list of the caller's emergency requests, newest first.
endpoints.description: Returns requests scoped to the authenticated account, ordered by created_at descending. page is 1-based and limit is clamped to 1-50 (default 10).

queryParams.name: page
queryParams.description: 1-based page. Values below 1 fall back to 1.

queryParams.name: limit
queryParams.description: Page size 1-50; values outside the range are clamped.

notes: Another account's requests are excluded from both items and total.

endpoints.name: Get one emergency request
endpoints.summary: Fetch a stored emergency request and its result snapshot.
endpoints.description: Returns the request, its stored results and the guidance. Requests owned by another account, unknown ids and malformed uuids all return 404 not_found so ownership is not disclosed.

pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: Emergency request id returned by POST /emergency.

guidance: Call 112 now if the situation is life-threatening, someone is unconscious, bleeding heavily, or struggling to breathe.
Call the nearest facility below and confirm they can accept the patient before travelling.
HealthAccess does not dispatch ambulances; these are live search results and are not verified by HealthAccess.

responses.label: Not Found
responses.description: Unknown id, malformed uuid, or a request owned by another account.

notes: results is the persisted snapshot; it does not perform a fresh search.
Always surface the 112 guidance alongside the stored results.
